visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male creator with dark hair and a gray patterned t-shirt sits in a studio, speaking directly to the camera. His face is expressive as he holds a white AirPods Pro 3 case, gesturing toward it with his fingers. The background consists of shelves with figures and books, illuminated by bright, soft studio lighting. (2) A close-up shot shows a hand holding a single white earbud outdoors against a bokeh background of green foliage and warm sunlight. This is followed by a split-screen comparison showing both AirPods Pro 3 and Pro 2 models held between fingertips. (3) The creator is seen wearing the earbuds, shaking his head vigorously to demonstrate the fit while maintaining a smiling facial expression in the studio setting. (4) Screen recordings of an Apple Watch and an iPhone appear, displaying real-time noise reduction data and decibel levels. (5) A macro close-up shows a white charging cable being inserted into the charging port of the AirPods case. Another screen recording shows a heart rate monitor fluctuating between 114 and 116 bpm on a smartphone. (6) The creator returns to a medium shot, gesturing with his hands to conclude his review. The final shot displays the official white AirPods Pro 3 product box resting on a desk surface.
